gsce_definition: Four SCDown transitions plus seven G4 CSP conv1s
gsce_roi_definition: GSCE plus unchanged original all-valid-GT ROI CE, weight 0.1
limits: AP75 depends on scores and localization; it does not isolate regression errors.
Training-loss means describe logged moving averages, not independent causal factors.
A small single-seed difference does not demonstrate an intrinsic module conflict.

gradient_probe.scope: Frozen raw epoch200 GSCE+ROI; 108 fixed strong-augmented train images; CPU FP32, isolated B36 batch-BN; gradients measured at the shared neck outputs before classification/regression towers; no parameter updates.
limitations: A local gradient cosine is not a causal decomposition of AP.
Neck features are detached to isolate the shared detection-head input; this does not measure parameter gradients in earlier backbone layers.
One checkpoint and three augmented batches do not establish the direction of auxiliary gradients throughout training.

paired_parameter_probe.scope: Two completed raw epoch300 models; identical 72 strong-augmented train images, isolated CPU FP32, real B36 batch BN. Backbone parameters are frozen; neck and classification-tower gradients are measured. No optimizer updates and no GPU use.
limitations: Local gradient directions do not causally decompose validation AP.
Only two batches at convergence are measured, not training history.
Backbone parameter gradients and AdamW preconditioning are not measured.
Strong augmentation here is a diagnostic input; formal last20 epochs use weak augmentation.
